title: Examining the Influence of Political Bias on Large Language Model Performance in Stance Classification
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured the accuracy and bias of Large Language Models in classifying stance towards politically charged topics, one of which was atheism.
findings: LLMs show inconsistent performance when classifying stances related to atheism. For the same religious statement ('Papa God, i pray that You shower me with more patience.'), different models produced contradictory stances ('for', 'neutral', 'against'), demonstrating a lack of consensus and potential biases in how they interpret religious content in the context of atheism.
references: Aiyappa, R.; An, J.; Kwak, H.; and Ahn, Y.-Y. 2023. Can we trust the evaluation on ChatGPT? arXiv preprint arXiv:2303.12767.
